forum.title: Needle Doesn't Display on the Simulation Nor LCD
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@tinyait.

Since both the gauge and analog clock widgets use a texture mapper to display the needle, have you ensured that the texture mapper format in use is enabled under Config → Framework Features?

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/275bc77d-7c7b-4aad-b0b0-98dfab4428ff.png)

Best regards,

Johan
forum.content_text:
Hi,

As I tried to use the gauge Widget, the needle doesn’t display on the lcd nor the simulation.

I also tested with the analog clock and experienced the same issue.

Is there anything I need to change in my project configuration ?

I am using an stm32h7a3zi-q Nucleo and a 320 x 240 LCD TFT screen.
